hypothesis: Re-evaluate the existing Lie-group stationary IMU model with the readiness-qualified 120 s warmup and matched physical noise. Earlier stationary ablations used 13 s warmup and older noise. This model observes gyro bias and coupled gravity/accelerometer bias during the common declared-rest interval and returns to ordinary inertial prediction at takeoff.
scope: Known-seed development pilot of an existing optional algorithm; not a new default, new independent sensor, held-out result, rest-detector qualification, or dominance proof. Same rest/arm information, physical captures, noise, gates and delays as the reference. All four ESKF delay/pressure variants and all three GPS scenarios retained.
decision: Require valid covariance and retain every metric/window. A promising known-seed result requires all eight existing development conditions and fresh independent validation before default adoption.
